description: This is a PHP interface file defining the ServerRequestInterface, which extends the RequestInterface to include methods specific to server-side HTTP request handling. It includes method signatures for retrieving and setting server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and request attributes, along with immutability guarantees.

classes.name: ServerRequestInterface
classes.description: An interface that extends RequestInterface to include server-specific HTTP request methods, ensuring immutability and standardized access to request data such as server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and attributes.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Retrieves data related to the incoming request environment, typically from $_SERVER.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Retrieves cookies sent by the client.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified cookies, ensuring immutability.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query string arguments.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified uploaded files.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Retrieves parameters from the request body.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified parsed body.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes derived from the request.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a single derived request attribute with a default value.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an added attribute.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specific attribute removed.
